first_attempt.outcome: Trained all eight arms, then stopped before any score at a zero-force pixel assertion that holds only for rest-anchored models. No result.

note: Eight arms from the E7 teacher and the D019 cache, seed 19, 8,000 updates each, on one A40 (TC2N01). Retrained controls are bitwise equal to D020 and D029 in model and EMA weights; the only config difference for rest_x1 is the two D029 weight fields, added later with value 0. Selection by select_scale, fixed at the rules revision. Checkpoints stay on TC2.

quality.scope: Strict single-reference engineering check. Hidden-physics coverage and action response are reported separately; this is not a physical-validity guarantee.
